facebook.caption:
28,096 reviews. 4.6 stars. This is not a normal zoo.

Vinpearl Safari Phú Quốc is an open conservation park where rare native species and exotic animals roam actual space, not concrete enclosures. You walk through it. Some of them walk past you.

Located at Bãi Dài on the northern tip of the island. Budget a half-day minimum.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
